account_deletions_completed_check.name: account_deletions_completed_check
account_deletions_completed_check.value: ("biblib"."account_deletions"."state" = 'completed') = ("biblib"."account_deletions"."completed_at" is not null and "biblib"."account_deletions"."purge_after" is not null and "biblib"."account_deletions"."step" = 'done')

cover_assets_size_check.name: cover_assets_size_check
cover_assets_size_check.value: ("biblib"."cover_assets"."bytes" is null or ("biblib"."cover_assets"."bytes" >= 1 and "biblib"."cover_assets"."bytes" <= 5242880)) and ("biblib"."cover_assets"."width" is null or ("biblib"."cover_assets"."width" >= 1 and "biblib"."cover_assets"."width" <= 10000)) and ("biblib"."cover_assets"."height" is null or ("biblib"."cover_assets"."height" >= 1 and "biblib"."cover_assets"."height" <= 10000))

cover_assets_ready_check.name: cover_assets_ready_check
cover_assets_ready_check.value: "biblib"."cover_assets"."state" = 'quarantine' or ("biblib"."cover_assets"."storage_key" is not null and "biblib"."cover_assets"."sha256" is not null and "biblib"."cover_assets"."mime" = 'image/webp' and "biblib"."cover_assets"."width" is not null and "biblib"."cover_assets"."height" is not null and "biblib"."cover_assets"."bytes" is not null)

editions_isbn13_check.name: editions_isbn13_check
editions_isbn13_check.value: "biblib"."editions"."isbn13" is null or biblib.isbn13_normalize("biblib"."editions"."isbn13") is not distinct from "biblib"."editions"."isbn13"

import_session_rows_source_check.name: import_session_rows_source_check
import_session_rows_source_check.value: ("biblib"."import_session_rows"."source_ordinal" is null) = ("biblib"."import_session_rows"."source_row_key" is null) and ("biblib"."import_session_rows"."source_ordinal" is null or ("biblib"."import_session_rows"."source_ordinal" >= 1 and "biblib"."import_session_rows"."source_ordinal" <= 1000000 and "biblib"."import_session_rows"."source_row_key" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9:_-]{1,128}$'))

import_sessions_csv_mapping_check.name: import_sessions_csv_mapping_check
import_sessions_csv_mapping_check.value: ("biblib"."import_sessions"."csv_mapping" is null) = ("biblib"."import_sessions"."csv_mapping_version" is null) and ("biblib"."import_sessions"."csv_mapping" is null) = ("biblib"."import_sessions"."mapping_sha256" is null)

import_sessions_csv_hashes_check.name: import_sessions_csv_hashes_check
import_sessions_csv_hashes_check.value: ("biblib"."import_sessions"."input_sha256" is null or "biblib"."import_sessions"."input_sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') and ("biblib"."import_sessions"."mapping_sha256" is null or "biblib"."import_sessions"."mapping_sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

import_sessions_csv_source_check.name: import_sessions_csv_source_check
import_sessions_csv_source_check.value: ("biblib"."import_sessions"."source" = 'csv') = ("biblib"."import_sessions"."input_sha256" is not null) and ("biblib"."import_sessions"."source" = 'csv' or "biblib"."import_sessions"."csv_mapping" is null)

import_sessions_preview_check.name: import_sessions_preview_check
import_sessions_preview_check.value: ("biblib"."import_sessions"."preview_id" is null) = ("biblib"."import_sessions"."preview_revision" is null) and ("biblib"."import_sessions"."preview_id" is null) = ("biblib"."import_sessions"."preview_expires_at" is null) and ("biblib"."import_sessions"."preview_id" is null) = ("biblib"."import_sessions"."plan" is null)

import_sessions_prepared_check.name: import_sessions_prepared_check
import_sessions_prepared_check.value: "biblib"."import_sessions"."state" not in ('prepared', 'committed') or "biblib"."import_sessions"."preview_id" is not null

library_jobs_import_check.name: library_jobs_import_check
library_jobs_import_check.value: "biblib"."library_jobs"."kind" <> 'import' or ("biblib"."library_jobs"."preview_id" is not null and "biblib"."library_jobs"."expected_revision" is not null)

library_jobs_lease_check.name: library_jobs_lease_check
library_jobs_lease_check.value: ("biblib"."library_jobs"."state" = 'running') = ("biblib"."library_jobs"."lease_token" is not null and "biblib"."library_jobs"."lease_until" is not null)

loans_borrower_label_check.name: loans_borrower_label_check
loans_borrower_label_check.value: char_length("biblib"."loans"."borrower_label") >= 1 and char_length("biblib"."loans"."borrower_label") <= 40 and "biblib"."loans"."borrower_label" = btrim("biblib"."loans"."borrower_label") and "biblib"."loans"."borrower_label" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]' and strpos("biblib"."loans"."borrower_label", '@') = 0 and char_length(regexp_replace("biblib"."loans"."borrower_label", '[^0-9]', '', 'g')) <= 6

loans_dates_check.name: loans_dates_check
loans_dates_check.value: "biblib"."loans"."loaned_on" >= '1900-01-01'::date and "biblib"."loans"."loaned_on" <= '2999-12-31'::date and ("biblib"."loans"."due_on" is null or ("biblib"."loans"."due_on" >= "biblib"."loans"."loaned_on" and "biblib"."loans"."due_on" <= '2999-12-31'::date)) and ("biblib"."loans"."returned_on" is null or ("biblib"."loans"."returned_on" >= "biblib"."loans"."loaned_on" and "biblib"."loans"."returned_on" <= '2999-12-31'::date))

media_assets_size_check.name: media_assets_size_check
media_assets_size_check.value: ("biblib"."media_assets"."bytes" is null or ("biblib"."media_assets"."bytes" >= 1 and "biblib"."media_assets"."bytes" <= case when "biblib"."media_assets"."kind" = 'avatar' then 1048576 else 5242880 end)) and ("biblib"."media_assets"."width" is null or ("biblib"."media_assets"."width" >= 1 and "biblib"."media_assets"."width" <= case when "biblib"."media_assets"."kind" = 'avatar' then 1024 else 4096 end)) and ("biblib"."media_assets"."height" is null or ("biblib"."media_assets"."height" >= 1 and "biblib"."media_assets"."height" <= case when "biblib"."media_assets"."kind" = 'avatar' then 1024 else 4096 end))

media_assets_ready_check.name: media_assets_ready_check
media_assets_ready_check.value: "biblib"."media_assets"."state" = 'quarantine' or ("biblib"."media_assets"."sha256" is not null and "biblib"."media_assets"."mime" = 'image/webp' and "biblib"."media_assets"."width" is not null and "biblib"."media_assets"."height" is not null and "biblib"."media_assets"."bytes" is not null and "biblib"."media_assets"."expires_at" is null)

reading_cycles_dates_check.name: reading_cycles_dates_check
reading_cycles_dates_check.value: "biblib"."reading_cycles"."started_at" is null or "biblib"."reading_cycles"."finished_at" is null or "biblib"."reading_cycles"."finished_at" >= "biblib"."reading_cycles"."started_at"

reading_entries_pages_check.name: reading_entries_pages_check
reading_entries_pages_check.value: ("biblib"."reading_entries"."page_from" is null or ("biblib"."reading_entries"."page_from" >= 0 and "biblib"."reading_entries"."page_from" <= 100000)) and ("biblib"."reading_entries"."page_to" is null or ("biblib"."reading_entries"."page_to" >= 0 and "biblib"."reading_entries"."page_to" <= 100000)) and ("biblib"."reading_entries"."page_from" is null or ("biblib"."reading_entries"."page_to" is not null and "biblib"."reading_entries"."page_from" <= "biblib"."reading_entries"."page_to"))

reading_entries_content_check.name: reading_entries_content_check
reading_entries_content_check.value: "biblib"."reading_entries"."page_to" is not null or "biblib"."reading_entries"."note" is not null

tags_name_check.name: tags_name_check
tags_name_check.value: char_length("biblib"."tags"."name") >= 1 and char_length("biblib"."tags"."name") <= 40 and "biblib"."tags"."name" = btrim("biblib"."tags"."name") and "biblib"."tags"."name" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'
